title: The box with four numbers coming out
description: A cardboard box with an arrow going in and an arrow coming out, four number tags 28, 36, 72 and 48 coming out, and a rabbit and a deer watching.

title: A box that multiplies by 6
description: A box marked times 6: the numbers 5, 7 and 9 go in and 30, 42 and 54 come out.

title: Every array of 18 tiles
description: The arrays of 18 tiles: 1 row of 18, 2 rows of 9 and 3 rows of 6, each written as a multiplication, with the factors of 18 listed.

title: 44 is a multiple of each of its factors
labels: 44 is a multiple of each of them
description: The arrays of 44 tiles written as 1 × 44, 2 × 22 and 4 × 11, with the factors 1, 2, 4, 11, 22 and 44 listed.

title: One array or two
description: One row of 19 tiles as the only array of 19, beside the two arrays of 21 tiles, 3 × 7 and 1 × 21.

title: Where Robby and Deeku both land
description: A number line from 0 to 30 with jumps of 2 in teal and jumps of 5 in amber, and 10, 20 and 30 boxed where both land.

title: Common multiples 30 apart
description: A number line from 0 to 90 with jumps of 6 and jumps of 15 meeting at 30, 60 and 90, each 30 more than the one before.

title: Jumps of 4 land on 8 and 20 only
labels: 4 is a common factor of 8 and 20
description: A number line from 0 to 28 with Mowgli's jumps of 4 landing on 8 and 20 and skipping 14 and 26.

title: Factors of 18 and of 30
labels: A jump of 1, 2, 3 or 6 lands on both 18 and 30
description: The factors of 18 and the factors of 30 as number chips, with 1, 2, 3 and 6 joined as the common factors.

title: Sorting by 2, 5 and 10
description: Three overlapping circles for divisible by 2, by 5 and by 10 with 16 and 48, 35 and 85, and 60 and 70 sorted into them, and none in the part for 10 only.

title: The trail through the chapter
description: A winding trail with six stops named factors and multiples, arrays, prime numbers, common multiples, common factors and checking statements.
